info.title: Business Box
info.description: Business Box is online booking software for small businesses in Japan. Connect it to list event types and open times, create and cancel bookings, send single use booking links, and start flows the moment a booking is created, rescheduled or cancelled.

get.description: Returns the Business Box account the API key belongs to and the permissions the key carries.

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown or revoked.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

get.description: Lists the event types customers can book, in the order they appear in Business Box.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Set to true to return only active event types, or false to return only inactive ones.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The Next Cursor value from the previous page.

get.description: Lists the start times that can be booked for an event type, after availability, calendar conflicts, buffers, notice and daily limits are applied. The range can span at most 31 days.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event type to check.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first date to check, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last date to check, in YYYY-MM-DD format. At most 31 days after From Date.

403.description: The API key does not carry the scope this operation needs.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

get.description: Lists bookings, newest first by default. Held and awaiting payment bookings are excluded unless you filter by those statuses.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma separated statuses to include: confirmed, cancelled, completed, no_show, held, awaiting_payment.

parameters.name: eventTypeId
parameters.description: Only return bookings for this event type.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Only return bookings made by this email address.

parameters.name: startFrom
parameters.description: Only return bookings that start at or after this time, in ISO 8601 UTC.

parameters.name: startTo
parameters.description: Only return bookings that start before this time, in ISO 8601 UTC.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only return bookings changed at or after this time, in ISO 8601 UTC.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order: -createdAt (newest first), start, -start or -updatedAt.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The Next Cursor value from the previous page.

post.description: Books a time for a customer, as adding a booking by hand in Business Box does. The customer is emailed a confirmation unless Send Confirmation is false. No card payment is taken. A time that is no longer free fails with error slot_unavailable.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The booking to create.

start.description: The start time in ISO 8601 UTC. Use a time from List available start times.

name.description: The full name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

locale.description: The language for emails to the customer: en or ja.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone of the customer, for example Asia/Tokyo.

notes.description: Notes to add to the booking.

notify.description: Whether to email the customer a confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value, such as a GUID, that makes retries safe. A repeated request with the same key returns the first result instead of creating a duplicate.

post.description: Cancels a booking as Business Box does: the customer is emailed, and a paid booking is refunded in full. Cancelling a booking that is already cancelled returns it unchanged.

parameters.name: body

post.summary: Create a single use booking link
post.description: Creates a booking link that works once and then stops. Use it to reply to an enquiry. It works for public and invite only event types.

parameters.description: The link to create.

eventTypeId.description: The event type the link books.

name.description: The name to prefill on the booking form.

email.description: The email address to prefill on the booking form.

expiresInDays.description: The number of days the link stays valid, from 1 to 90.

id.description: The unique identifier of the booking.

status.description: The booking status: held, awaiting_payment, confirmed, cancelled, completed or no_show.

start.description: The start time of the booking in ISO 8601 UTC.

end.description: The end time of the booking in ISO 8601 UTC.

hostTimezone.description: The IANA time zone of the host, for example Asia/Tokyo.

eventType.description: The event type that was booked.

id.description: The unique identifier of the event type.

name.description: The name of the event type in the host language.

nameI18n.description: The event type names in each supported language.

slug.description: The URL slug of the event type.

booker.description: The person who made the booking.

name.description: The full name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer, if given.

locale.description: The language of the customer: en or ja.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone of the customer.

answers.description: The answers the customer gave to the booking questions.

questionId.description: The unique identifier of the question.

label.description: The question label in the host language.

labelI18n.description: The question labels in each supported language.

value.description: The answer as text. Checkbox answers are true or false.

bookerNotes.description: Notes the customer added to the booking.

kind.description: The location type: google_meet, teams, zoom, phone, in_person or custom.

direction.description: For phone meetings, who calls whom: host_calls or booker_calls.

hostPhone.description: For phone meetings, the phone number of the host.

address.description: For in person meetings, the address.

text.description: The custom location text in each supported language.

joinUrl.description: The video meeting link, when the location is an online meeting.

source.description: How the booking was made: public, manual or reschedule.

payment.description: Payment details. Empty for free event types.

amount.description: The price in minor currency units. JPY has no minor unit, so 5000 is 5,000 yen.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code, for example jpy.

status.description: The payment status: unpaid, paid, refunded, partially_refunded or failed.

refundedAmount.description: The refunded amount in minor currency units.

receiptUrl.description: A link to the payment receipt.

cancellation.description: Cancellation details. Empty unless the booking was cancelled.

by.description: Who cancelled the booking: booker, host or system.

reason.description: The reason given for the cancellation.

at.description: When the booking was cancelled, in ISO 8601 UTC.

manageUrl.description: The link that opens this booking in Business Box.

createdAt.description: When the booking was created, in ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedAt.description: When the booking was last changed, in ISO 8601 UTC.

nextCursor.description: Pass this value as Cursor to get the next page. Empty on the last page.

id.description: The unique identifier of the event type.

name.description: The name of the event type in the host language.

nameI18n.description: The event type names in each supported language.

slug.description: The URL slug of the event type.

durationMinutes.description: The length of the meeting in minutes.

visibility.description: Whether the event type is public or invite_only.

active.description: Whether the event type can currently be booked.

bookingUrl.description: The public booking page link for this event type.

price.description: The price. Empty for free event types.

amount.description: The price in minor currency units. JPY has no minor unit, so 5000 is 5,000 yen.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code, for example jpy.

payOnArrival.description: Whether the customer pays in person instead of online.

locationKind.description: The location type: google_meet, teams, zoom, phone, in_person or custom.

createdAt.description: When the event type was created, in ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedAt.description: When the event type was last changed, in ISO 8601 UTC.

items.description: The event types on this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this value as Cursor to get the next page. Empty on the last page.

slots.description: The start times that can be booked, in ISO 8601 UTC.

items.description: A start time that can be booked.

calendarBlocked.description: True when a connected calendar could not be checked, so no times are offered.

Account.description: The Business Box account the API key belongs to.

id.description: The unique identifier of the account.

name.description: The display name of the account.

email.description: The email address of the account.

handle.description: The booking page handle of the account.

locale.description: The language of the account: en or ja.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone of the account.

bookingPageUrl.description: The public booking page link of the account.

plan.description: The subscription plan: free or standard.

scopes.description: The permissions the API key carries.

id.description: The unique identifier of the invite.

eventTypeId.description: The event type the link books.

url.description: The single use booking link. Send it to the customer.

name.description: The name the booking form is prefilled with.

email.description: The email the booking form is prefilled with.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working, in ISO 8601 UTC.

usedAt.description: When the link was used. Empty until it is used.

bookingId.description: The booking made with the link. Empty until it is used.

createdAt.description: When the link was created, in ISO 8601 UTC.

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription.

url.description: The address events are delivered to.

status.description: Whether the subscription is active or disabled.

createdAt.description: When the subscription was created, in ISO 8601 UTC.

BookingEvent.description: A booking event delivered by Business Box.

id.description: The unique identifier of the event. Use it to ignore duplicate deliveries.

type.description: What happened: booking.created, booking.rescheduled, booking.cancelled or booking.no_show.

createdAt.description: When the event happened, in ISO 8601 UTC.

apiVersion.description: The version of the payload format, currently v1.

previous.description: For booking.rescheduled, the time the booking had before it moved.

id.description: The booking ID before the move.

start.description: The start time before the move, in ISO 8601 UTC.

end.description: The end time before the move, in ISO 8601 UTC.
